name: Glencore plc
source: CRON 2026-10-14: H1 2026 column added from Glencore plc 2026 Half-Year Report, condensed consolidated statement of income for the six months ended 30 June 2026 (unaudited), page 27, from glencore.com. US dollars million stored as absolute dollars: Revenue 174,430; cost of goods sold 167,798; net expected credit losses 3; selling and administrative expenses 1,534; share of income from associates and joint ventures 964; gain on disposals of non-current assets 579; other income 413; other expense 389; impairments of non-financial assets 364; impairments of financial assets 104; dividend income 50; interest income 324; interest expense 1,681; income before income taxes 4,887; income tax expense 277; income for the period 4,610; attributable to equity holders 4,405 with 205 attributable to non-controlling interests; basic and diluted earnings per share 0.37 US dollars. Mapping follows the file own treatment: Operating Expenses is gross profit less the pre-tax result before net finance costs, that is selling and administrative expenses plus net expected credit losses plus impairments plus other expense, less other income, share of associates and joint ventures, disposal gains and dividend income; Net Finance Costs is interest expense less interest income, so operating profit less net finance costs equals the printed income before income taxes; Net Profit follows the file own convention of the attributable figure (4,405): income before income taxes less the 277 tax expense is 4,610, the remaining 205 being non-controlling interests.

The FY2024 column of both tables reproduces the stored -998 and -1,634 exactly, so the basis matches the rest of the series.
